messages:
Asha (People Ops): Posting a short follow-up from today’s All-Hands Q&A about promotions/leveling/comp. I’ll include the manager-friendly answers so teams get consistent messages.

Diego (Eng Manager): Thanks  can you confirm the promotion timetable and when letters land? A few teammates asked after the meeting.

Asha (People Ops): Timeline: managers submit calibration packets by 2026-11-05, calibration panels 2026-11-12, exec committee 2026-11-19, letters go out 2026-11-26. Appeals: 14 calendar days after letters.

Nina (SWE): If an appeal is approved, do raises get backdated? Payroll timing?

Liam (Comp): Yes  approved base increases are backdated to the cycle effective date noted in the committee memo and processed on the next payroll after HR posts the change (usually ~1 payroll run). Equity follows normal grant cadence unless an off-cycle grant is approved.

Diego (Eng Manager): Folks also want a short script for 1:1s when someone isn’t promoted. Can People Ops share something we can reuse?

Asha (People Ops): Manager script (copy/paste): 
"Lead with appreciation (what stood out). State the outcome (promotion: yes/no). Give 3 concrete growth milestones with owner + dates. Offer follow-up check-in in 6-8 weeks. Share resources + invite questions."

Nina (SWE): Are equity refreshers automatic with promotions? And how do we request them in the packet?

Asha (People Ops): Not automatic. In the calibration template there’s an "Equity request" checkbox. Managers should add rationale and suggested grant size/percentile. Equity committee reviews with comp.

PeopleBot: Reminder: calibration-template-v2 is in /handbook/people-ops/calibration/2026. Upload packets to that folder. :pushpin:

Sam (CEO): Leadership note: managers, be specific and kind. If a case has material retention impact, tag me + Asha with the packet link and a 1-2 sentence business rationale.

Asha (People Ops): Quick copy-paste action items for managers: 1) Use calibration-template-v2 2) Upload by 2026-11-05 3) Check equity box if relevant + include comps 4) Expect letters 2026-11-26, appeals 14 days 5) Use the manager script above in 1:1s.

Diego (Eng Manager): Appreciate it  can you also add a short return-to-work script for folks coming back from leave? We had one ask.

Asha (People Ops): Will add a short return-to-work paragraph to the manager packet and post the manager digest tomorrow. Closing thread; DM me or Liam for urgent escalations. :sparkles:
